measured_problem: Under the actual passing replacement layer-zero prefix, the fixed rank-768 layer-one residual oracle captures 0.964438 residual energy against 0.98, passes mean cosine at 0.996208, and narrowly misses mean relative RMSE at 0.0800376 against 0.08. The worst held-out record is abstention at 0.233311 RMSE, while hard routing is exact on all 4228 records. The output-span deficit is therefore small, route-localized in its worst case, and cannot be repaired by another coefficient optimizer within the same rank-768 output column space.
proposed_architecture: Add one hard-route-selected diagonal bypass to the residual branch: elementwise multiply the post-attention normalized full-width feature by one learned full-width vector selected by the already persistent top-1 route, then add it beside the existing rank-768 residual output. This provides coordinate-aligned directions outside the rank-768 output projection without a dense full-width matrix, a second attention path, source blocks, or additional route evaluation.
first_screen: One read-only no-artifact feasibility screen on the unchanged 4200/28 records. Derive the unchanged rank-768 train PCA basis, fit exactly one route-specific diagonal least-squares vector per existing route to the train residual component orthogonal to that basis, and evaluate validation with direct rank coefficients plus the learned route diagonal. Require adjusted train residual capture of at least 0.98, validation mean cosine at least 0.995, validation mean relative RMSE at most 0.08, exact routes, and artifact immutability.
decision: Authorize exactly one separately preregistered route-diagonal residual capacity screen. A pass only authorizes a realizable coefficient-plus-diagonal layer-one fit and physical runtime screen under separate protocols. A fail closes this CPU-conscious bypass without diagonal, route, rank, width, data, optimizer, source, or gate variants.
claim_boundary: Architecture review and active-compute accounting only; no model, checkpoint, autonomous quality, physical runtime, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
